label: TP
reason: User input flows directly to response.getWriter().format() as the format string parameter. The doSomething() function only trims the last character but leaves the rest intact, allowing %n, %s, or other format specifiers to be injected into the format string used by PrintWriter.format(), creating XSS vulnerability.

evidence.note: User input param flows through doSomething() and reaches response.getWriter().format() as format string without proper sanitization
response.getWriter().format(bar, obj) sinks tainted data as format string
